title: 算 Step 4 · Everyday Maths: 倍, 打折, 增加了 vs 增加到
description: 打八折 means you pay 80%, not 80% off. 增加了一倍 doubles it, 增加了两倍 triples it. The everyday maths in shops and news.

points.title: 打折: you pay that many tenths
points.summary: 打 N 折 = pay N/10 of the price: 打八折 = 80% of the price (20% off). 半价 = half price.
points.body:
- 一百块的衣服**打八折** → 八十块
- **打七折** → 七十块 (30% off)
- **半价** / 打五折 → 五十块

| | say | example |
|---|---|---|
| **+** | 加 jiā | 三**加**五**等于**八 (3 + 5 = 8) |
| **−** | 减 jiǎn | 十**减**四等于六 (10 − 4 = 6) |
| **×** | 乘 / 乘以 chéng(yǐ) | 六**乘以**七等于四十二 |
| **÷** | 除以 chúyǐ | 十**除以**二等于五 · ⚠️ 二**除**十 = 10 ÷ 2 too! |
| **=** | 等于 děngyú | (spoken: 是) |
| **¾** | 四**分之**三 — bottom number first | 二分之一 = ½ |
| **3.5 · 20% · −5** | 三**点**五 · **百分之**二十 · **负**五 | 0.08 = 零点零八 |
| **×2 · 20% off** | 两**倍** · 打**八折** (pay 80%) | 增加了一倍 = doubled |

points.title: 倍: times; 增加了 vs 增加到
points.summary: 两倍 = ×2. But **增加了**一倍 = grew **by** 100% (×2), **增加了两倍** = grew by 200% (×3). **增加到**两倍 = grew **to** ×2.
points.body:
- 我的工资是他的**两倍**。 I earn twice what he does.
- 去年一百人，今年**增加了一倍** → 二百人。
- **翻了一番** = doubled.

| **÷** | 除以 chúyǐ | 十**除以**二等于五 · ⚠️ 二**除**十 = 10 ÷ 2 too! |

examples: The number of students has doubled this year.

questions.prompt: A sign says 「{打|dǎ}{八|bā}{折|zhé}」. What do you pay?
questions.explanation: 打 **N** 折 = you pay **N tenths**.
notes: The classic mistake: 八折 is what you **pay**.
折 is a fraction, not an amount.

questions.prompt: A jacket costs 100 块. What do you pay?
items: {便宜|piányi}{了|le}{百分之三十|bǎi fēn zhī sānshí}
questions.explanation: 打 N 折 = N × 10%; 便宜了 X = minus X.

questions.prompt: 「{我|wǒ}{的|de}{工资|gōngzī}{是|shì}{他|tā}{的|de}{两|liǎng}{倍|bèi}。」 He earns 5,000. I earn …
「{去年|qùnián}{有|yǒu}{一百|yìbǎi}{个|ge}{学生|xuésheng}，{今年|jīnnián}{增加|zēngjiā}{了|le}{一|yí}{倍|bèi}。」 How many now?
notes: That would be 增加了两倍.
questions.translation: Last year there were 100 students; this year the number has doubled.

questions.prompt: Start at 100. Where do you end up?
items: {增加|zēngjiā}{了|le}{百分之五十|bǎi fēn zhī wǔshí}
questions.explanation: **增加了** = by (add on top) · **增加到** = to (the new total).

questions.prompt: Build it: 'All the clothes are 30% off.'
questions.explanation: 所有衣服都**打七折**。 30% off = pay 70% = 七折.

questions.prompt: Which mean 'twice as much (× 2)'? Select all.
questions.explanation: × 2 = 两倍 = 增加了一倍 = 翻了一番.

notes: That would be 四百平方米.
